name: Snowdonia
about: Best hiking runs Apr–Oct; the summit trails are genuinely hazardous in winter without proper ice gear and experience.
overview: Eryri National Park's mountains, including Snowdon, Wales's highest peak — dramatic ridgelines, slate-quarry history, and some of the best hiking in Britain.
costOverview: Typical pricing for rural Wales — a Welsh cake and coffee cost a reasonable few pounds, and the Snowdon Mountain Railway is the one real splurge most visitors build into a day.
